title: Vast press quotes
description: A warm-grey band with a 48px title and two square arrow buttons, a horizontal strip of quote cards separated by thin vertical hairlines (outlet name on top, a 20px quote under it; three and a bit across on desktop, one with the next peeking on phones), and below it a long row of outlet names that drifts left forever and also slides sideways as you scroll past.
notes: outlet names are plain text in four styles (heavy, mono, italic, light); swap in real logo images through the `mark` field
the strip scrolls by one card per arrow press and snaps; the marquee loop is CSS only and stops under reduced motion
uses the theme's card colour as the band
